report: We're 2-7 after losing 83.9 to 128.8, but the lineup is already the best one available. Flournoy at 10.29 doesn't beat J. Williams at 12.74 or Stevenson at 11.52, and Williams has a good spot against NE, which ranks 2nd in points allowed to WR. We have no injured starters. Omar Cooper Jr. (15.65 avg) is Out on the bench, so keep him. The weak spots are QB (Stafford 13.09 over the last 3), RB2 (White 9.74) and TE (LaPorta 5.43 over the last 3). Send the Zaneruth offer first: Stroud averages 20.5 with a 16.5 floor against Stafford's 16.26 and 9.4. Several offers use the same bench pieces (Stevenson, White, Dell, Flournoy), so only send the ones that don't overlap once one is accepted.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 16.26 but only 13.09 over the last 3, with a 9.4 floor. He is a weekly risk.
Javonte Williams averages 16.73, but White (9.74) and Stevenson (11.52) are weak and no RB on the roster beats 12.
Higgins averages 19.04 (23.1 over the last 3) and McMillan 14.56. Cooper (15.65) is Out, and Flournoy and Dell are depth around 10.
LaPorta averages 10.63 but only 5.43 over the last 3. Mayer (8.56) is a backup, not an upgrade.
J. Williams at 12.74 and Stevenson at 11.52 are fine, but neither has a ceiling above 18.
Cooper, McConkey and Strong are all Out, and Black (5.81) and McGowan (4.64) can't start.

plan: Land a QB upgrade (Stroud, 20.5 avg, 16.5 floor) using the WR depth of Flournoy and Dell.
Replace RB2 White (9.74) with Swift (17.09) or Tuten (16.39).
Get a steadier TE floor (Kelce 7.04 or Goedert 7.72) over LaPorta's 5.02.
